He answered, “Don’t be afraid; for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
You will not need to fight this battle. Set yourselves, stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh with you, O Judah…
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.
translations.bsb: “Do not be afraid,” Elijah said to her. “Go and do as you have said. But first make me a small cake of bread from what you have, and bring it out to me. Afterward, make some for yourself and your son,
translations.kjv: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.
translations.asv: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said; but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it forth unto me, and afterward make for thee and for thy son.
